goal: Let callers cap the length of a slug.

tasks.title: Add slugMax
tasks.description: Cap a slug at max characters without leaving a trailing dash.
scenarios: Given the title "Hello, World!" When slugMax is called with max 5 Then it returns "hello"
Given the title "ab cd ef" When slugMax is called with max 3 Then it returns "ab" (no trailing dash)
Given any title When slugMax is called with a max at least as long as the slug Then it equals the slug
changelog: slugMax truncates a slug to a maximum length
